entries.statement: Composition/refinement capability does not imply a chosen N1 update algebra.
entries.proof: Take finite typed records under associative disjoint/interface union and identity refinement maps, with no update relation declared.

entries.statement: Finite relaxation does not imply any nonconstant conserved readout.
entries.proof: On S={0,1}, U(1)=0 and U(0)=0. P(x)=x strictly descends on 1→0; any U-invariant f has f(1)=f(0), hence is constant.

entries.statement: Exact recurrence/conservation does not imply a strict well-founded relaxation monotone.
entries.proof: For an involution s, P(sx)≤P(x) and P(x)=P(s(sx))≤P(sx), hence equality. Therefore no strict decrease under any involutive legal move.

entries.statement: PAIRWISE_EQUALIZATION_REWRITE exactly conserves C(x)=Σx(v).
entries.proof: Every move subtracts one from one endpoint and adds one to the other.
entries.bounded_regression: checker exhausts small paths and total token counts.

entries.statement: Every nontrivial M1 move strictly decreases P(x)=Σx(v)^2 by 2(d-1) for local difference d≥2.
Every M1 branch terminates.
entries.proof: P is a nonnegative integer and decreases by at least 2 on every nontrivial step.
entries.bounded_regression: small-state transition graph contains no nonterminal cycles.

entries.statement: Arbitrary block-sum coarse graining is not dynamically lumpable.
entries.proof: On path 1-2-3-4 with blocks {1,2},{3,4}, states (2,0,0,0) and (1,1,0,0) have identical block sums (2,0) but different legal internal/cross-edge updates.
entries.implication: Do not upgrade M1 block sums to a general refinement dynamics.

entries.statement: SIGNED_CANCELLATION_LEDGER conserves q_a=p(a)-n(a) and decreases total token count by exactly 2 per cancellation.
entries.proof: Each cancellation subtracts one from p(a) and n(a).

entries.statement: All M2 cancellation branches reach the unique normal form NF(q).
entries.proof: For each type a, cancellations stop exactly when one sign count is zero; the surviving count is |q_a| with sign sign(q_a), independent of order.
entries.bounded_regression: checker explores all branches in small boxes.

entries.statement: Normal-form representatives are not monoidal under raw composition.
entries.proof: NF(+1)⊕NF(-1) contains two tokens, while NF((+1)⊕(-1)) is empty.
entries.implication: The additive object is q, not the raw normalized representative.

entries.statement: BINARY_CARRY_RELAY on L cells is one cycle of length 2^L.
entries.proof: The update visits states in the unique carry sequence; inductively a length-(L+1) chain traverses the L-prefix cycle twice, once for each terminal bit state.

entries.statement: Over one full M3 orbit, carry reaches level k≥1 exactly 2^(L-k) times, yielding exact fraction 1/2^k.
entries.proof: A carry into level k occurs exactly when the k lower bits are all 1; among 2^L states, 2^(L-k) satisfy that predicate.

entries.statement: Every scalar invariant under the full M3 action is constant.
entries.proof: The action has a single orbit on the 2^L states.
entries.implication: M3 cannot supply a nonconstant conserved scalar without additional structure.

entries.statement: FINITE_UNION_PROPAGATION conserves global union U and strictly decreases deficit P on every nontrivial edge update.
entries.proof: Replacing S_u,S_v by S_u∪S_v leaves the union over all vertices unchanged; P drops by |S_u△S_v|.
entries.bounded_regression: checker exhausts small connected paths and atom sets.

entries.statement: On each connected component, every maximal nontrivial M4 branch terminates at the constant state equal to the component's initial union.
entries.proof: Finite P strictly descends. A terminal state has equal sets on every edge; connectedness forces one set on the component; conservation of U identifies it.

entries.statement: Conserved union cardinality is not extensive.
entries.proof: Two one-vertex components each carrying the same atom a have |U1|=|U2|=1 but |U1∪U2|=1≠2.

entries.statement: For y=f_i(x), principal reachable sets satisfy O(y)⊆O(x), so r(x)=|O(x)| is nonincreasing.
entries.proof: Every state reachable from y has form y·m=x·f_i·m and is therefore reachable from x.
entries.bounded_regression: checker exhausts all one/two-generator endofunction systems on three states.

entries.statement: Mutual reachability yields equal principal reachable sets and a finite quotient preorder by inclusion.
entries.proof: x→*y gives O(y)⊆O(x); y→*x gives the reverse inclusion.

entries.statement: Independent direct-product actions multiply principal orbit sizes.
entries.proof: O((x,y))=O_M(x)×O_N(y), hence cardinalities multiply.
entries.implication: Provides an exact composition law for one N2 response carrier.

entries.statement: Transformation-semigroup closure alone does not imply NB-B coexistence.
entries.proof: Permutation actions have r constant and no strict descent; a constant map has immediate descent but only constant invariants on a transitive collapse.
entries.implication: Low-description generator structure plus an independent invariant is still needed.

entries.statement: CONSERVATIVE_SWAP_GROUP preserves label multiplicities on each connected component and is exactly recurrent/reversible.
entries.proof: Every generator is an edge transposition; transpositions preserve label counts and are involutions.
entries.bounded_regression: checker enumerates binary-label orbits on small paths.

entries.statement: No nonconstant P can be nonincreasing under every M6 swap while strictly decreasing under any legal swap.
entries.proof: For swap s=s^{-1}, P(sx)≤P(x) and applying the same inequality to sx gives P(x)≤P(sx); equality follows.
entries.implication: Pure reversible local swaps cannot pay the genuine-relaxation part of NB-B.
